reviews.text: Regal Custom Pools designed a grotto for me to mesh with my existing pool, and built it to match the landscaping.  Not an easy task when the pool wasn't really built for a grotto.  They are a great company, and the owner is actively involved and honest as honest gets.  If you need any pool services or pool landscaping, I can't recommend them enough.

We wanted to remodel our pool and move the hot tub from the middle of the pool to the end.  The original hot was quite large and constricted the middle of the pool.  Deleting it and moving it to the end would open up the entire pool surface.  I reached out to a few pool remodeling companies and they all told me it couldn't be done.  Might as well start from scratch.  However, when Regal Custom Pools came out for our meeting, the owner Mike Gajewski told me his team could make our vision a realit

Our pool was 20+ years old and was in need of full renovation. After new coping, tile, plaster and a redesign of the spa I barely recognize it. It’s so nice it makes me wish I had done it earlier. I would definitely use Regal again.

Mike and his team are great to deal with. They handle all my pool maintenance and weekly chemicals. My pool is in great shape. Pool water always seems perfect. They handle any other maintenance or repairs quickly and they treat their customers great.

Mike and the team are the best pool company I have seen in the DFW area.   Highly  recommended.  Always going the extra mile for the customer.   His team is attentive, very knowledgeable, always there when we need them.    If there was 10 stars I would rate them that!!

Regal Pool is a first call pool & spa service. I have recommended them to several of my close friend and the work they do is exceptional.
Highly recommend them!!
We have used Regal for 4 years for regular maintenance, and last year had them resurface and install new tile and coping.  They have provided excellent service.
Have used Regal Custom Pools a couple of times. Great, fast reliable service for anything pool related

Loved working with Mike and his crews.  Everyone was prompt, professional and did an amazing job remodeling my pool.  I'm delighted in the outcome and can hardly wait for warm weather to be able to fully enjoy it.  I will always recommend Regal Pools for any pool remodels or installations.

Thank you Mike & team - great job!

We contracted Regal Pools to transform our older pool and backyard into a cool place for our grown kids.  We turned our dive pool into a sports pool, added a 9 foot wide by 14 inches deep swim shelf for our grand kids, resurfaced and extended our pool deck, added a stone coping and re plastered the pool with a beautiful dark blue plaster.  Regal's team is very efficient, very polite and very good at what they do.  We turned our pool area into an oasis and I couldn't be happier with the job they
Highly recommend using this company. They have helped me so much, especially Logan. He is the best and knows how to help with every problem I have! Wouldn’t use anyone else!!

Unbelievable service. All the crews were on time everyday that they promised to show up. They committed to be finished in eight weeks and the finished two weeks ahead of schedule. For once I got a contractor that did what he committed to. It was pleasure working with Rega Pools.
